notes.title: Yollen - MAJOR UPDATE
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45626095/a7b1c32cb88ceed7f92c1a2b3328ac3ba8375804.png"][/img][/p][h3]
Hey Adventurers,[/h3][p][/p][p][b]The biggest update has just dropped for Yollen, reshaping the game for the better[/b][/p][p][/p][p]I’ve been working on improving progression flow, adding more content, and fixing the annoying issues you’ve pointed out and I really hope the game feels much better now.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What's new:[/b] [/p][list][*][p][b]Smoother XP progression[/b] - leveling is now a lot faster and more natural[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rebalanced item stacks[/b] - cooked and smelted items will have twice the stack size (and a bit more)[/p][/*][*][p][b]New achievements[/b] - and yes, that means more inventory slots[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved auto-save logic[/b] – no more corrupted saves[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lots of new content[/b] - including items, smoother progression tools, and surprises to discover[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smarter auto-consume[/b] - it will only consume when needed and not immediately as it used to[/p][/*][*][p][b]Updated translations[/b] - better support for more players around the world[/p][/*][*][p][b]And much more...[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]I really hope it makes the game more enjoyable now - and even more so for those who’ve enjoyed it from the start.[/p][p][/p][p][b]If you enjoy the new update, I’d be grateful if you consider leaving a review on Steam - it helps a lot![/b][/p][p][/p][p]As always, please keep the feedback coming - here in the Community Hub or on [b][url="https://discord.gg/Fq2ype9kCd"]Discord[/url][/b][/p][p][/p][p]Hope you enjoy the grind - and get your revenge on goddamn Yollen[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3721490/Yollen/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]New content: [/h2][p][/p][h3]New skill levels:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Fighting Skill - notes.title: Thank you & QOL Improvements Update #1
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45626095/69f00691de47f9cf07360cd5b2b5072f480e1a57.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Hey Adventurers,[/b] [/p][p][/p][p][b]Huge thanks to everyone for the support![/b] I’m really happy that Yollen is now out on Steam ːccheartː[/p][p][/p][p]As requested, the new update is now live.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The new build comes with lots of community-requested improvements:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Move items in the inventory[/p][/*][*][p]Vsync[/p][/*][*][p]Frame Rate Cap[/p][/*][*][p]New Achievement for more backpack space[/p][/*][*][p]Improved visuals[/p][/*][*][p]Lots of bug fixing[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Keep the comments coming so I can keep making the game better [b]and I’d be very grateful if you could leave a review on Steam! [/b]🙏[/p][p][/p][p][i][u]aim for the heavens[/u][/i][/p]
